# symbolicUserContactTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicUserContactTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserContactTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  CreateSphereSphereContact of UserItemCreator (#3187), ObjectConnectorUser with the linear normal contact
#           force of ObjectContactSphereSphere (impactModel 0, no friction), switched by the gap of the state, against
#           mbs.CreateSphereSphereContact, which switches by its data node in the post-Newton step: a ball - a user
#           mass point under gravity - falls onto a fixed sphere off its axis, bounces off and falls onto a second
#           sphere; by RK44, the Python and the recorded user items against the built-in ones without damping, and
#           SymbolicSystem with SolveExplicit against SolveDynamic with damping. The built-in contact switches at the end
#           of a step by its data node, the user contact within it by the gap, so they agree to the step size, not to
#           the bit; with damping not even that, as the damping pulls the separating spheres together, and the implicit
#           solver does not converge with the step size for the user contact (#3188).
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-01
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.symbolics.userItems import UserItemCreator
from exudyn.symbolics.systemModel import SymbolicSystem
from exudyn.symbolics.solvers import SolveExplicit
import numpy as np

radius = 0.1
k = 1e5

def Build(userItems, record=False, d=0.):
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    creator = UserItemCreator(mbs) if userItems else mbs
    ground = creator.CreateGround()
    ball = creator.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[0.05, 0.4, 0], mass=0.5, gravity=[0, -9.81, 0], drawSize=2*radius)
    for (position, sphereRadius) in [([0, 0, 0], 0.2), ([0.6, -0.4, 0], 0.15)]:
        creator.CreateSphereSphereContact(itemNumbers=[ground, ball], localPosition0=position,
                                          spheresRadii=[sphereRadius, radius], contactStiffness=k, contactDamping=d)
    if record:
        creator.Record()
    mbs.variables['creator'] = creator #the recordings live as long as the system
    mbs.Assemble()
    return (SC, mbs, ball)

simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 16000
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.8
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False

def Position(mbs, ball):
    return np.array(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(ball, exu.OutputVariableType.Position, localPosition=[0, 0, 0]))

def Positions(d):
    """the positions at the end of the built-in, the Python and the recorded user items"""
    results = []
    for (userItems, record) in [(False, False), (True, False), (True, True)]:
        (SC, mbs, ball) = Build(userItems, record, d)
        mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings, solverType=exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44)
        results.append(Position(mbs, ball))
    return results

#without damping, the user contact and the built-in one have the same solution, to the step size
results = Positions(0.)
differenceBuiltIn = max(np.max(np.abs(results[1] - results[0])), np.max(np.abs(results[2] - results[0])))
exu.Print('without damping: ball at t=0.8', results[0], ', user items against built-in', differenceBuiltIn)

#with damping, the damping force pulls the spheres together when they separate at a small overlap: switched at the end
#of a step by the data node (built-in) or within the step by the gap (user item), the solutions differ by more than the
#step size; the recorded user item equals the Python one
resultsDamped = Positions(20.)
differenceRecorded = np.max(np.abs(resultsDamped[2] - resultsDamped[1]))
exu.Print('with damping: user items against built-in', np.max(np.abs(resultsDamped[1] - resultsDamped[0])),
          ', recorded against Python', differenceRecorded)

#the recorded user items as SymbolicSystem, by SolveExplicit, against SolveDynamic of the same items
(SC, mbs, ball) = Build(True, True, 20.)
SolveExplicit(SymbolicSystem(mbs), simulationSettings, solverType=exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44)
differenceSystem = np.max(np.abs(Position(mbs, ball) - resultsDamped[2]))
exu.Print('SymbolicSystem by SolveExplicit against SolveDynamic:', differenceSystem)

u = np.sum(results[0]) + int(differenceBuiltIn > 1e-5) + int(differenceRecorded > 1e-12) + int(differenceSystem > 1e-10)
exu.Print('solution of symbolicUserContactTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
